lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×30

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hey, friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Here's a thank-you gift for helping me with my getaway!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Seems like it doesn't want to go through.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The signal isn't that great up at this altitude after all!
Don't worry, your gift came through.
Failed to send message.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh well!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hoping that these messages will find their way to you eventually.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: First, I'll say all that I want to say to you!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: After we parted ways, I've been riding atop Mother Whale.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: My friends and I have been exploring the skies.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The view from up here is truly breathtaking,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I can never find the right words that will do it justice.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: However, what's more phenomenal are my Rapture companions.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Although I don't make any repair noises or have a flashing core,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: they show absolutely no aggression towards me.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Thanks to that, I'm now free to make sketches of their appearances and

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: work on different communication methods with them.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I've never been happier in my life!
It's a relief to hear you're safe.
Sounds like you're having a good time.
Failed to send message.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Ah, right! I've been thinking about something lately.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: When Raptures and humans first encountered each other

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: in the first war,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I wonder who was the first to pull the trigger?
Raptures
Humans
Failed to send message.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: When I was a kid, I was taught that Raptures were the aggressors.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Now I'm not so sure that's true. In fact, I'm starting to think it may have been the opposite.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I guess I'm starting to get attached to these guys!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Well, you can guess all you want about the past,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: but the truth will always be one tough nut to crack.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Whoa, Mother Whale

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: is increasing in altitude.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I don't think I'll be able to send any more messages.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Look after yourself.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Next time you see a Rapture,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: have faith in them!
You look after yourself as well.
I'll do that.
Failed to send message.
